summary: We introduce Hydra-0, a generalist world model conditioned on action flow, which represents robot actions as pixel motion. title: KV Cache Compression Through the Lens of Transform Coding
summary: The key-value (KV) cache stores information from past tokens and is a major memory bottleneck in long-context inference. We prove that, under a white-noise quantization model, the expected attention-aware distortion decomposes into additive key and value contributions that factor across tokens and channels.
